headline: environmental routeability determines the ecological cost of heterogeneity

ecological_claims.primary: raw environmental heterogeneity and effective ecological complexity can be decoupled by routeability
ecological_claims.richness: species or state richness can increase without increasing task-specific decision complexity when additions remain within existing decision-equivalence classes
ecological_claims.niche_breadth: routeable heterogeneity can reduce the information cost of broad niche use, but does not determine niche breadth by itself
ecological_claims.community: routeability can further filter compatibility-permitted interactions into the behaviorally accessible subset; it does not replace morphology, phenology, encounter or downstream demographic filters
ecological_claims.temporal: environmental persistence matters through persistence of decision-relevant heterogeneity rather than autocorrelation alone

terminology.environmental_routeability: task-specific relational property whereby early cues partition ecological alternatives so later information is needed only within the realized branch
terminology.effective_complexity: represented by the task-specific pair (C_A, C_F), not by a universal scalar
terminology.decision_equivalence_class: ecological states sharing the focal target and remaining cross-target discrimination requirements

theorem_policy.stop_rule: Do not add new theorem families. Further work may only improve ecological interpretation, claim scope, figures, literature positioning, or submission quality.

remaining_machine_work: add a permanent archive DOI if one is minted before submission
promotion_rule: V5 is the preferred environment-centered submission candidate. Its machine submission bundle is frozen and checksum-verified. V4 remains preserved as fallback. Submission remains blocked only on author-controlled metadata, approvals, simultaneous-submission confirmation, and any archive DOI.

reproducibility.note: The repository reproducibly freezes the V5 Markdown/SVG source surface. The line-numbered DOCX, rendered PDFs and checksum-frozen staging ZIP are machine-side validated export artifacts; byte-for-byte reconstruction of those exported binaries from the repository alone is not claimed.

remaining_human_work: confirmation that the manuscript is not under consideration elsewhere

post_freeze_extensions.central_inference: compositional novelty is not necessarily decision novelty; taxonomic turnover can be decision-silent or branch-changing
post_freeze_extensions.formal_basis: existing target-relevant world quotient / decision-equivalence result
post_freeze_extensions.promotion_rule: Promote only if revision needs an invasion, turnover, biodiversity-loss, or ecological-novelty bridge; prefer replacing existing discussion text rather than adding a fourth headline concept.
post_freeze_extensions.reason_to_hold: The extension is theorem-backed and connects routeability to turnover and homogenization, but the initial V5 submission remains cleaner with environmental routeability as the single headline concept.
post_freeze_extensions.secondary_inference: effective decision complexity can remain invariant across substantial within-class turnover and change disproportionately when turnover crosses a decision-equivalence boundary
post_freeze_extensions.tertiary_inference: multiple states within one decision-equivalence class can buffer the focal decision structure against some turnover until the final class representative is lost
post_freeze_extensions.claim_boundary: This is interaction-specific structural buffering, not ecosystem resilience, functional redundancy, or biodiversity insurance.

post_freeze_extensions.central_question: among network transitions with similar species turnover and rewiring opportunity, does crossing a decision-equivalence boundary predict more rewiring than within-class turnover?
primary_predictions: low taxonomic turnover plus decision-boundary crossing predicts more rewiring among shared species than matched no-crossing transitions
within-class turnover is a structural negative control against taxonomic distance alone

loss of a final decision-class representative is predicted to be more likely to alter accessibility structure than comparable non-final loss; this direction is empirical, not guaranteed by the quotient theorem
decision-structural change can accompany rewiring even with little species turnover
post_freeze_extensions.anti_circularity_rule: freeze decision-equivalence classes independently of the observed rewiring response
post_freeze_extensions.promotion_rule: Promote only for reviewer-requested testability, an identified empirical network with independently measurable decision structure, or a dedicated rewiring follow-up; keep the initial V5 headline unchanged.
post_freeze_extensions.claim_boundary: The reserve predicts a constraint on behaviorally accessible rewiring, not a third beta-diversity component, universal network-resilience metric, or unqualified causal effect.
post_freeze_extensions.formal_empirical_boundary: exact result: non-final within-class loss can leave the declared contingent decision problem invariant; empirical hypothesis: final-representative loss is more likely to alter rewiring opportunity, not guaranteed to change observed rewiring

post_freeze_extensions.central_result: no Tier A public dataset identified; Villavicencio six-year plant-pollinator data are the strongest current Tier B pilot because repeated networks, morphology, phenology and abundance are jointly available

strongest_candidate.dataset: Chacoff, Vazquez & Lomascolo / Peralta et al. Villavicencio plant-pollinator network
strongest_candidate.reason_not_tier_a: independent contingent cue/decision structure is not supplied; morphology and phenology are compatibility filters, not exact decision-equivalence classes

other_candidates.dataset: Colom et al. 2026 Catalan butterfly-plant network
other_candidates.admission: Tier B-minus; long-term rewiring response but current public surface lacks independent decision-cue exposure

other_candidates.dataset: CaraDonna et al. 2017 RMBL weekly turnover
other_candidates.admission: Tier C for present test; public surface is aggregate turnover/simulation output
Tier B-minus reserve pending independent decision-cue surface

post_freeze_extensions.next_gate: Stage 1 feasibility reanalysis on Villavicencio before collecting or importing an independent decision-structure layer
post_freeze_extensions.anti_proxy_rule: do not label morphology or trait clusters as decision equivalence merely because they predict rewiring
post_freeze_extensions.promotion_rule: public-data work remains feasibility analysis until either a Tier A observational dataset is identified or an independent experimental decision-structure layer is added to a Tier B network response

post_freeze_extensions.central_result: Kent Island supplies a direct independent colour-learning layer linked to a real plant-pollinator network, but the network-facing cognition contrast has only six independent pollinator species and is not confirmatory-ready for a species-level routeability claim

strongest_candidate.admission: A-cognition source; confirmatory NO-GO at current independent-unit count
assets: independent colour-learning experiment in six Hymenoptera species
strongest_candidate.novelty_boundary: do not repeat the published specialization-versus-learning result as a new headline
strongest_candidate.reason_not_confirmatory: the direct learning assay spans six pollinator species; visits or dyads cannot be treated as independent replication of a species-level cognition exposure

triangulation.network_response: Villavicencio repeated link dynamics and frozen conventional-filter baseline
triangulation.cognition_network: Kent Island independent colour learning plus field network
triangulation.decision_cost_experiment: Austin et al. 2018 floral marketplace factorial experiment

post_freeze_extensions.next_gate: prioritize a controlled routeability experiment that manipulates branch structure independently of species composition and realized network response; retain Kent as mechanistic calibration/source-design template
post_freeze_extensions.claim_boundary: Kent can calibrate direct cognition and restricted colour-channel structure but cannot confirm full V5 routeability; no dyad-level pseudoreplication of a six-species cognition exposure

post_freeze_extensions.central_result: phenological overlap is the only prespecified conventional-filter block with reproducible incremental held-out information for both annual link gains and losses under the frozen strict-core rule
post_freeze_extensions.sensitivity: phenology retains reproducible_incremental_information for both endpoints in near-core 4/4 and all-annual 5/5 folds
post_freeze_extensions.next_gate: freeze an independent cognition/decision exposure without redefining the conventional baseline
post_freeze_extensions.claim_boundary: predictive filter attribution only; no causal primacy, decision-equivalence, or routeability inference

post_freeze_extensions.central_test: matched four-state cue architectures crossed with contingent versus fixed information access under a two-cue budget

exact_contrast.matched: four states, 2+2 targets, three unit-cost binary cues, identical per-cue outcome multiplicities

B1.interpretation: below adaptive cost; adaptive-policy prefix q_route versus one-terminal fixed prefix

B3.interpretation: all cues available; above fixed cost

post_freeze_extensions.promotion_rule: preferred first direct empirical test because branch structure is manipulated independently of species composition and observed network response
post_freeze_extensions.claim_boundary: a positive controlled experiment would establish behavioral consequences of matched cue architecture, not natural-network rewiring or ecosystem-level effects
post_freeze_extensions.behavioral_feasibility: present route cue before the terminal cue but keep context visible during terminal presentation; match timing/persistence and pretest cue discriminability

pairwise_information_nonidentifiability.result: routeable and bypass-control tasks have identical named pairwise information signatures across target and all three cues, but C_F differs 3 versus 2 while C_A=2 in both
pairwise_information_nonidentifiability.consequence: strict adaptive gain is not identifiable from the pairwise mutual-information surface alone
pairwise_information_nonidentifiability.novelty_boundary: generic higher-order synergy and XOR-style pairwise insufficiency are prior art; the contribution is the exact minimal routeability-versus-bypass construction
pairwise_information_nonidentifiability.experiment_value: the symbolic control matches pairwise information strength, so the architecture-by-access contrast isolates higher-order conditional organization more tightly than cue-marginal matching alone

higher_order_localization.interpretation: the strict-gain route cue carries target information that is absent from the fixed terminal pair; the bypass control has no such residual conditional information

schedule.design: architecture x access x budget all between subjects; 12 cells
schedule.state_balance: each four-trial block contains all four states once
schedule.cue_symbol_counterbalance: four orthogonal profiles within each cell
schedule.sample_size_boundary: multiple of four per cell is a counterbalance requirement only, not the powered N

analysis_gate.H2: B2 interaction minus mean B1/B3 interaction
analysis_gate.model: binomial logistic mixed model; individual and colony grouping explicit
analysis_gate.sample_size_status: not frozen; must use nuisance-parameter calibration rather than theoretical 0.25 ceiling

training_selection_firewall.rule: no architecture-specific accuracy exclusion after random assignment; use fixed-dose architecture-specific training
training_selection_firewall.diagnostic: report training acquisition/completion by randomized cell
training_selection_firewall.hard_criterion_boundary: criterion-reacher analysis is per-protocol if operationally unavoidable

primary_endpoint_firewall.timeout: retained and scored as primary failure

pilot_and_power.allowed_pilot_information: response window, pooled B3 success, timeout/dropout, repeated-trial correlation, colony heterogeneity and procedural failure
pilot_and_power.forbidden_feedback: H1/H2 or B2 architecture-by-access effects cannot define the power target; theoretical 0.25 ceiling cannot be used as the behavioral effect size
pilot_and_power.sesoi: must be frozen from an external biological/practical source
pilot_and_power.final_N_status: pending final GLMM simulation after nuisance receipt and real colony allocation are frozen

operating_characteristics.scientific_rule: final N must be chosen only after real nuisance inputs, external SESOI, colony allocation and a prespecified robustness grid are frozen
operating_characteristics.fixture_boundary: CI synthetic fixture is software validation only and is not power evidence

relational_witness.interpretation: the physical cue environment is identical across architecture groups; routeability changes through the focal target/reward mapping
relational_witness.apparatus_value: the same physical stimuli can be reused across architectures
